property_summary: For any amount, after funding c and calling c.forward(payableSink, "") the contract's balance is unchanged, because forward uses a plain call so the callee's code executes in its own (empty) context; the mutant's delegatecall runs the callee's code in c's context, letting it drain c's balance.
change_summary: Change the call to a delegatecall so the callee executes in the contract's storage/context.
